user_query: Which specific classes are instantiated and returned by the WorkerFactory.CreateWorkers() method?

response.answer: The WorkerFactory.CreateWorkers() method instantiates and returns three specific worker classes: WorkerA, WorkerB, and WorkerC. The method is implemented as a public static method in the WorkerFactory class (located in HelloWorldApp/WorkerFactory.cs) that returns an IEnumerable<IWorker>. The implementation creates a new List<IWorker> containing instances of all three worker classes, each instantiated with the provided INotifier parameter passed to their constructors. The method body contains the return statement: 'return new List<IWorker> { new WorkerA(notifier), new WorkerB(notifier), new WorkerC(notifier) }'. All three worker classes (WorkerA, WorkerB, WorkerC) implement the IWorker interface and are located in their respective .cs files within the HelloWorldApp directory. Each worker class accepts an INotifier parameter in its constructor, allowing them to perform callbacks as indicated by the method's explanatory comment: '// create multiple workers, each knows how to call back'.

raw_results.discovery_query: MATCH (f:Function {name: 'CreateWorkers'})-[:CONTAINS]->(b:Block)-[:CONTAINS]->(s:Statement) WHERE s.text CONTAINS 'new' WITH s.text AS statement_text RETURN statement_text, [worker IN ['WorkerA', 'WorkerB', 'WorkerC'] WHERE statement_text CONTAINS worker | worker] AS used_workers, [worker IN ['WorkerA', 'WorkerB', 'WorkerC'] WHERE statement_text CONTAINS ('new ' + worker + '(') | worker] AS instantiated_workers
raw_results.verification_query: MATCH (f:Function {name: 'CreateWorkers'})-[:CONTAINS]->(b:Block)-[:CONTAINS]->(s:Statement) WHERE s.text CONTAINS 'new' WITH s.text AS statement_text RETURN statement_text, [worker IN ['WorkerA', 'WorkerB', 'WorkerC'] WHERE statement_text CONTAINS worker | worker] AS used_workers, [worker IN ['WorkerA', 'WorkerB', 'WorkerC'] WHERE statement_text CONTAINS ('new ' + worker + '(') | worker] AS instantiated_workers

raw_results.claim: All three worker classes connect to CreateWorkers function through 'workers' variable with consistent reference patterns

evidence.summary: Query returned 3 results showing each worker class connects through variable_name='workers' with reference_count=1. All have all_variables=['workers'] confirming consistent connection pattern through the same Variable node.

raw_results.discovery_query: MATCH (f:Function {name: 'CreateWorkers'})-[:CONTAINS|REFERENCES]->(v:Variable)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Type) WHERE t.name IN ['WorkerA', 'WorkerB', 'WorkerC'] RETURN t.name AS worker_class, v.name AS variable_name, COUNT(*) AS reference_count, COLLECT(DISTINCT v.name) AS all_variables ORDER BY t.name
raw_results.verification_query: MATCH (f:Function {name: 'CreateWorkers'})-[:CONTAINS|REFERENCES]->(v:Variable)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Type) WHERE t.name IN ['WorkerA', 'WorkerB', 'WorkerC'] RETURN t.name AS worker_class, v.name AS variable_name, COUNT(*) AS reference_count, COLLECT(DISTINCT v.name) AS all_variables ORDER BY t.name

raw_results.claim: Cross-reference verification confirms all three worker classes exist, are used in statements, and have variable references in CreateWorkers function

evidence.summary: Comprehensive verification query returned 3 results with all boolean flags set to true: class_exists=true, used_in_statements=true, has_variable_reference=true for all three worker classes. Each has its respective class_file_path in HelloWorldApp directory, confirming complete integration in the CreateWorkers function.

raw_results.discovery_query: WITH ['WorkerA', 'WorkerB', 'WorkerC'] AS all_workers UNWIND all_workers AS worker_name OPTIONAL MATCH (t:Type {name: worker_name}) OPTIONAL MATCH (f:Function {name: 'CreateWorkers'})-[:CONTAINS]->(b:Block) WHERE b.statements CONTAINS worker_name OPTIONAL MATCH (f2:Function {name: 'CreateWorkers'})-[:CONTAINS|REFERENCES]->(v:Variable)-[:REFERENCES]->(t) RETURN worker_name, CASE WHEN t IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS class_exists, CASE WHEN b IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS used_in_statements, CASE WHEN v IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS has_variable_reference, t.file_path AS class_file_path ORDER BY worker_name
raw_results.verification_query: WITH ['WorkerA', 'WorkerB', 'WorkerC'] AS all_workers UNWIND all_workers AS worker_name OPTIONAL MATCH (t:Type {name: worker_name}) OPTIONAL MATCH (f:Function {name: 'CreateWorkers'})-[:CONTAINS]->(b:Block) WHERE b.statements CONTAINS worker_name OPTIONAL MATCH (f2:Function {name: 'CreateWorkers'})-[:CONTAINS|REFERENCES]->(v:Variable)-[:REFERENCES]->(t) RETURN worker_name, CASE WHEN t IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS class_exists, CASE WHEN b IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS used_in_statements, CASE WHEN v IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS has_variable_reference, t.file_path AS class_file_path ORDER BY worker_name

raw_results.discovery_query: MATCH (f:Function {name: 'CreateWorkers'})-[:CONTAINS]->(b:Block)-[:CONTAINS]->(s:Statement) WHERE s.text CONTAINS 'new' WITH s.text AS statement_text UNWIND ['WorkerA', 'WorkerB', 'WorkerC'] AS worker_class RETURN worker_class, CASE WHEN statement_text CONTAINS worker_class THEN true ELSE false END AS is_used, CASE WHEN statement_text CONTAINS ('new ' + worker_class + '(notifier)') THEN true ELSE false END AS uses_notifier_constructor, CASE WHEN statement_text CONTAINS ('new ' + worker_class + '(') THEN true ELSE false END AS has_constructor_call ORDER BY worker_class
raw_results.verification_query: MATCH (f:Function {name: 'CreateWorkers'})-[:CONTAINS]->(b:Block)-[:CONTAINS]->(s:Statement) WHERE s.text CONTAINS 'new' WITH s.text AS statement_text UNWIND ['WorkerA', 'WorkerB', 'WorkerC'] AS worker_class RETURN worker_class, CASE WHEN statement_text CONTAINS worker_class THEN true ELSE false END AS is_used, CASE WHEN statement_text CONTAINS ('new ' + worker_class + '(notifier)') THEN true ELSE false END AS uses_notifier_constructor, CASE WHEN statement_text CONTAINS ('new ' + worker_class + '(') THEN true ELSE false END AS has_constructor_call ORDER BY worker_class
